caption: The drawing depicts a section of a wooden architectural element, possibly a cornice or molding, adorned with painted decorative patterns. The wood appears weathered and is illustrated in light brown tones with visible grain lines. The upper portion features a horizontal band with a repeated floral motif, each flower composed of green, yellow, and orange shapes, connected by looping red arcs and thin green stems. Below this, a narrower band is decorated with a row of small circles, each outlined in red and filled with blue, set among a continuous red line, with one blue flower visible at the left end. The lower, curved portion of the molding displays more decorative painting, including yellow, green, and red swirling elements forming a stylized pattern, with a small floral motif in the middle. The composition is executed with delicate linework and subdued colors, utilizing mainly red, green, yellow, and blue over the wood’s pale background. The drawing is centered on a plain, light background with the artist's signature, "Harry M. Waldenil," inscribed at the lower right.
title: Painted Decorations on Ceiling
